name: import-session
description: Shows which Claude profile (config dir) you are in, and imports sessions for this project from your other profiles

profiles.title: Profiles to list
profiles.description: Config dirs whose sessions /import-session lists, comma-separated: a name like claude-work (meaning ~/.claude-work), a ~/ path or an absolute path. The current profile is always left out.

otherProfiles.title: Other profiles (folded)
otherProfiles.description: Config dirs listed only with /import-session --others, same format. Empty: every other ~/.claude* dir that has a projects folder.

showProfile.title: Show the current profile
showProfile.description: Show the current profile's name (and its emoji, if set) at the end of the hint line under the prompt, where "auto mode on" shows.

profileEmoji.title: Emoji per profile
profileEmoji.description: Optional emoji per profile, comma-separated name=emoji pairs, e.g. claude=🔑, claude-work=💼, claude-personal=🏠. Shown under the prompt and in the /import-session list.

autoResume.title: Resume after import
autoResume.description: Switch to the session right after /import-session copies it. Override per run with --no-resume (or --resume when this is off).
